english.title: Implant a microchip in a cat when unqualified (England)
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) implanted a microchip in a cat, namely **(..IDENTIFY CAT..), when not authorised under the Microchipping of Cats and Dogs (England) Regulations 2023
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 10(1) and 14(2(b) of the Microchipping of Cats and Dogs (England) Regulations 2023.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
not being a person identified in regulation 10(1)(a), (b) or (d)
implanted a microchip in a cat

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: For the offence in relation to dogs see H101327.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant, implanted a microchip in a cat, namely **(..IDENTIFY CAT..), when not authorised under the Microchipping of Cats and Dogs (England) Regulations 2023.

other.penalty:
Summary: a fine not exceeding level two on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

maxfinetypemagct.description: fine not exceeding level two on the legislative standard scale
